value.rationale: One-vertex individualization of directed counting refinement is a natural symmetry detector. The exact first obstruction and full classification at size eight give a meaningful finite boundary, with a structural mechanism tracing both exceptions to a single regular nonvertex-transitive seven-vertex tournament. Known tournament counts alone do not answer this invariant.
